verdict.rationale: Netlify documents automatic DDoS protection as a platform default. However, it never documents a web application firewall applied to every request by default: Advanced Security is a separate higher-tier offering, and Arcjet is a third-party integration that earns no credit. A concrete community report of a $104k bill after a DDoS on a static site suggests the attack traffic was served and billed rather than absorbed, which undercuts the depth of the DDoS claim. Missing for 10: a documented default WAF on every request, details on DDoS mitigation scope and behavior, and independent confirmation that DDoS traffic is actually filtered.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can have DDoS protection and a web application firewall applied to every request by default
